IGUI_TCA_Instructions: Click the green dot, hold and follow the dotted line.
IGUI_TCA_RefNoBody: No corpse on this table: generic model
IGUI_TCA_InstrOpen: Grip the incision edge with forceps and pull gently outward.
IGUI_TCA_InstrRibsCutter: Click a marker and hold to cut the rib.
IGUI_TCA_InstrRibsSaw: Click a marker and saw up and down.
IGUI_TCA_InstrDone: Autopsy complete: all organs have been removed.
IGUI_TCA_CutterSlip: The cutters slipped off the rib
IGUI_TCA_SawSlip: The saw jumped out of the cut
IGUI_TCA_InstrAttach: Cut the attachments: start at the green marker, follow the dots.
IGUI_TCA_InstrExtract: Grab the organ and gently lift it out of the body.
IGUI_TCA_OrganTooFast: Too fast: you nicked the organ
IGUI_TCA_OrganDetail_1: Early decomposition: died a day or two ago.
IGUI_TCA_OrganDetail_2: Clear decomposition: died several days ago.
IGUI_TCA_OrganInfected: Blackened, hardened tissue: typical signs of the infection.
IGUI_TCA_InstrPlastron: Grab the chest plate and lift it out.
IGUI_TCA_ExamInstr: Examine the body, then set your range on the timeline.
IGUI_TCA_ExamHint_temp: hold the thermometer under the armpit without moving
IGUI_TCA_ExamHint_jaw: grab the chin and pull down
IGUI_TCA_ExamHint_arm: grab the hand and pull up
IGUI_TCA_ExamHint_livor: press the purple patch on the flank and hold
IGUI_TCA_ExamHint_decomp: hold the click on the abdomen to observe it
IGUI_TCA_ExamLivorBlanch: The patch blanches completely under pressure.
IGUI_TCA_ExamLivorPartial: The patch pales but does not disappear.
IGUI_TCA_ExamLivorFixed: The patch does not blanch under pressure.
IGUI_TCA_ExamDecomp1: Greenish patch on the lower abdomen.
IGUI_TCA_ExamDecomp2: Bloated abdomen, marbled veins under the skin.
IGUI_TCA_ExamDecomp3: Advanced decomposition: skin slipping, very strong smell.
IGUI_TCA_ExamDecomp4: Very advanced decomposition: tissue liquefied in places.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide1: Temperature: a body loses about 1 °C per hour at first, then more and more slowly, until it reaches room temperature after about a day.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide2: A body colder than the room has been kept in the cold: its temperature no longer tells anything about the time of death.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide3: Rigor: it appears between 2 and 6 h, is complete around 12 h, then fades between 24 and 48 h.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide4: It starts in the jaw and moves down to the limbs, then fades in the same order.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide5: Jaw stiffer than the arm: rigor is setting in. Arm stiffer than the jaw: it is fading.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide6: Lividity: visible between 30 min and 4 h. It blanches under pressure before 6 h, only pales between 6 and 12 h, then becomes fixed.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide7: Decomposition: green patch on the lower abdomen around 1 to 3 days, bloating and marbling around 3 to 7 days, advanced decomposition after 1 to 3 weeks.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide8: Cold slows rigor and decomposition: a body kept in the cold looks fresher than it is.
IGUI_TCA_ExamGuide9: Cross-check the clues: each one gives a range, keep where they overlap.
IGUI_TCA_DebugCold: Cold total: %1 h, left the cold: %2
IGUI_TCA_InstrRibsOscillating: Click a marker and hold the saw in place.
IGUI_TCA_OscillatingSlip: The blade slipped off the rib
